Grills.Rafikis Beef Ribs: Beef ribs rubbed in our East African spice blend and charred over an open flame.
Grills.Chooza Chicken: Boneless chicken in our East African twist on tikka, flame-grilled and smoky.
Grills.Beef Mishkaki: Swahili street-food skewers of marinated beef, grilled until juicy and tender.
Grills.Lamb Chops: Marinated in East African spices, then seared for a caramelised crust.

Snacks.Beef Samosas: An East African favourite. Hand-folded golden pastry filled with lightly spiced minced beef.
Snacks.Mogo: Fried cassava, crisp and golden, fluffy inside. Plain or with chilli and salt.

Sides.Rafikis Rice: Spiced rice with seasonal vegetables and a gentle kick of heat.
Sides.Rafikis Fries: Golden fries tossed in our house-made pili pili seasoning.
Sides.Regular Fries: Crispy golden fries with a pinch of salt.

Desserts.Mandazi Ice Cream Sandwich: Warm East African fried dough filled with vanilla ice cream.
Desserts.Chai Affogato: Hot Kenyan chai poured over vanilla ice cream.
Desserts.Mandazi (2 pcs): East African fried dough, golden outside and soft inside.
Desserts.Chai: Kenyan chai, slow-brewed with milk and warming spices.
